snippet.title: Heroes of Might & Magic: Olden Era - Gameplay Trailer | Fantasy Turn-Based Strategy
snippet.description:
A new legend is born! Heroes of Might & Magic: Olden Era is the official prequel hailing back to the origins of the genre-defining, critically acclaimed series of turn-based strategy games. 

Set in the lands of Jadame, a mysterious continent only referenced but never explored in the Heroes of Might and Magic series, Olden Era features new factions, biomes, and creatures that bring fresh breath into the world and lore. 

Wishlist Heroes of Might & Magic: Olden Era on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3105440/Heroes_of_Might_and_Magic_Olden_Era/
